animations.name: Combat Idle Loop
animations.prompt: Seamless fighting idle loop starting and ending in the exact reference guard pose. Preserve pixel art, face, black outfit, proportions, scale and right-facing view. Gentle visible breathing, subtle torso and shoulder sway, small natural arm and fist movements while keeping both hands raised in guard. Soft rhythmic knee bends and ankle flexion; smoothly alternate weight between front and rear foot with slight heel lifts, feet staying in place. Stay alert and combat-ready. No attacks, walking, jumping or turning. Fixed camera, full body visible, no zoom, no effects.
